insight: Founded in 2024 in Berkeley, California and backed by education investor NewSchools Venture Fund.
name: Diffit
tagline: AI that adapts reading materials to any level for teachers.
description: Diffit lets teachers paste a topic, article URL, or YouTube link and instantly generates leveled reading passages with summaries, vocabulary, and comprehension and discussion questions. Outputs can be set to different reading levels and 100+ languages, then pushed straight to Google Classroom. Free for individual educators, with paid Pro and school/district plans.

modelSupport.notes: Uses an underlying LLM to generate and level content; not user-configurable.

edge: Purpose-built for differentiation: one click turns any text, URL, or video into the same passage at several reading levels with ready-made questions.
cons: Unlimited use needs a paid plan
